description.value:
You've mastered field medicine. Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Medicine skill, or expertise in it if you're already proficient. During a short rest, you can tend to as many as six willing beasts or humanoids, making a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check for each. On a success, if that creature spends a Hit Die during the rest, it may forgo the roll and instead regain the maximum number of hit points the die could provide; a creature can benefit from this only once per rest, no matter how many Hit Dice it spends.
